exclude_YEAR: YEAR kept as metadata only (not a patient-level predictor; consistent with documented RESEARCH_VARIABLES list)
feature_encoding: integer-coded categoricals kept as int (no one-hot). Standard SMOTE/ADASYN applied to integer codes: SMOTENC was rejected by imbalanced-learn 0.14.2 (all-categorical feature sets unsupported); this matches published BRFSS-SMOTE convention. Synthetic values validated within observed ranges.

resampling.scope: TRAIN ONLY; test set never touched
resampling.notes: sampling_strategy='auto': minority class resampled to majority size; k_neighbors=5 (SMOTE/ADASYN); all resampling random_state=42; TRAIN ONLY.
